svg.title: The larger steps of the blueprint
svg.desc: 0.1 to 0.3 brought seven kinds of projects, the settings as code and the release bot; 0.4 and 0.5 the settings bot, Renovate and the beta channel; 0.6 to 0.8 the websites, SLSA Build Level 3 and signed tags; 0.9 to 0.12 the diagrams that every app shows, the PR coach and the bot-health bot. The next release brings the screenshot bot; next come the visual changes in pull requests.
